topic: Kite day in the park: their kite gets stuck in a tree and they find a clever, safe way to get it back.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Tree-Tangled Kite

shots.narration: Oh no! Their kite has found a leafy landing spot!
shots.scene: Sunny park beneath a small tree, colourful diamond kite caught on a low twig, vertical 9:16, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno points at the kite caught just above their heads.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, bright green leaves, wide-eyed surprise.

shots.narration: Their wonderful kite day had started with a perfect breeze.
shots.scene: Park grass beneath the same tree, kite string leading upward, picnic blanket and open supply bag nearby, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi holds the kite spool with the string hanging loosely.
shots.mood: Soft golden light, cheerful colours, mild disappointment.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno's paws are brave, but much too short.
shots.scene: Grass beneath the low kite-bearing twig, kite clearly visible overhead, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno stretches one front paw upward while keeping three paws grounded.
shots.mood: Playful frustration, floppy ears, friendly rounded shapes.

shots.narration: Mishi studies the twig instead of pulling harder.
shots.scene: Close view beneath the tree, kite frame resting over a thin twig, loose string below, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi examines the kite's frame on the twig.
shots.mood: Thoughtful green eyes, gentle leaf shadows, calm concentration.

shots.narration: A little lift could free it from that twig.
shots.scene: Open kite supply bag on the park blanket, long lightweight cardboard tube protruding, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi pulls the cardboard tube from the bag.
shots.mood: Bright discovery, warm colours, hopeful expression.

shots.narration: [excited] Bruno knows exactly where their soft blanket belongs!
shots.scene: Flat grass directly beneath the low trapped kite, clear space around the tree, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno spreads the picnic blanket beneath the kite.
shots.mood: Eager teamwork, sunny grass, cheerful blue blanket.

shots.narration: Both friends keep their paws safely on the ground.
shots.scene: Full view of the small tree, blanket below the kite, Mishi beside Bruno, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi positions the cardboard tube beneath the kite frame.
shots.mood: Steady paws, relaxed faces, soft warm lighting.

shots.narration: Mishi gently lifts the frame above the tiny twig.
shots.scene: Low branch above the picnic blanket, tube touching the kite's sturdy lower frame, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi lifts the kite clear of the twig with the tube.
shots.mood: Careful concentration, clear uncluttered view, hopeful warmth.

shots.narration: [giggles] Down it floats, onto their soft landing spot!
shots.scene: Picnic blanket beneath the tree, empty twig overhead, tube lowered beside Mishi, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The freed kite settles onto the blanket.
shots.mood: Gentle triumph, delighted faces, bright kite colours.

shots.narration: Bruno carries their kite somewhere with plenty of open sky.
shots.scene: Wide grassy park clearing well away from trees, open blue sky above, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno carries the kite into the open clearing.
shots.mood: Confident smiles, spacious sunny setting, renewed excitement.

shots.narration: Now their kite dances where branches cannot reach!
shots.scene: Open park clearing, colourful kite high against blue sky, Mishi holding the spool beside Bruno, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The kite sways above the two friends.
shots.mood: Joyful relief, soft clouds, rich cheerful colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Safe teamwork wins; next, a picnic surprise!
shots.scene: Picnic blanket in the open clearing, recovered kite resting nearby, closed wicker basket between the friends, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno lifts the basket lid toward himself, hiding its contents.
shots.mood: Cosy anticipation, curious green eyes, playful warm sunlight.

episode.endHook: Next time, what's hiding inside their picnic basket?
episode.description: A lovely kite day takes a tiny twist when their kite catches on a low branch! Mishi and Bruno discover that careful thinking and teamwork can bring their fun safely back down.
